import { Component } from '@angular/core'; import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common'; import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms'; @Component({ selector: 'app-achievements-admin', standalone: true, imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule], template: `

🏆 Achievements

{{editingId ? 'Edit' : 'Add New'}} Achievement

{{a.icon}}

{{a.title}}

{{a.description}}

{{a.points}} pts {{a.unlocked ? 'Unlocked' : 'Locked'}} {{a.category}}
` }) export class AchievementsAdminComponent { showForm = false; editingId: number | null = null; formData = { title: '', description: '', icon: '🏆', points: 100, category: 'Learning', unlocked: false }; achievements: any[] = [ { id: 1, title: 'First Steps', description: 'Complete your first lesson', icon: '🎯', points: 50, category: 'Learning', unlocked: true }, { id: 2, title: 'Quiz Master', description: 'Score 100% in 5 quizzes', icon: '🧠', points: 200, category: 'Learning', unlocked: true }, { id: 3, title: '7-Day Streak', description: 'Study for 7 consecutive days', icon: '🔥', points: 150, category: 'Streak', unlocked: true }, { id: 4, title: 'Course Champion', description: 'Complete a full course', icon: '🎓', points: 500, category: 'Milestone', unlocked: false }, ]; save() { if (this.editingId) { const i = this.achievements.findIndex(a => a.id === this.editingId); if (i > -1) this.achievements[i] = { ...this.formData, id: this.editingId }; } else { this.achievements.push({ ...this.formData, id: Date.now() }); } this.resetForm(); } edit(a: any) { this.editingId = a.id; this.formData = { ...a }; delete (this.formData as any).id; this.showForm = true; } delete(a: any) { if (confirm('Delete?')) this.achievements = this.achievements.filter(x => x.id !== a.id); } resetForm() { this.formData = { title: '', description: '', icon: '🏆', points: 100, category: 'Learning', unlocked: false }; this.editingId = null; this.showForm = false; } }
